investigation_notes.Description: An Office 365 login for Elena.Vasiliev@client.ee succeeded from Singapore (IP 103.1.64.118) using the Windows Azure AD authentication provider and MFA was completed. The source IP is attributed to China Unicom infrastructure with a data center/hosting usage type, which increases contextual risk, but the IP shows a low abuse score and the user agent and MFA match recent legitimate logins from Estonia. Given the presence of multi-factor authentication, consistent user agent, lack of other suspicious signals, and no prior similar alerts, this activity is assessed as Low Priority because it more likely represents an unusual but authorized access pattern rather than an active compromise.
